source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 24 aprilie — «Sfântul Mucenic Sava Stratilat»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 24ης Απριλίου — «Άγιος Σάββας ο Στρατηλάτης, ο Γότθος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 24 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing and the same day the Romanian calendar keeps him. **This folder had no `dates` and now has a death year** off the page's heading «(; - 272)» and its closing sentence. The Greek adds that he was a Goth by descent — the day's line calls him ο Γότθος — that he lived in the third century, in the years of the emperor Aurelian, whose reign it dates 270 to 275, and served at Rome; that the emperor did not know he was a Christian and that he took no care to hide it when the Christians were being persecuted and imprisoned, but carried food to the prisoners himself; that the prison officers denounced him; that his sides were torn and his wounds burned with lighted torches; that because his rank was high the news of his execution brought crowds; that he was thrown into a boiling cauldron of pitch and came out unharmed, at which seventy of the idolaters believed and were beheaded on the spot — the Seventy Soldiers the calendar keeps on this same day, who now have a folder; and that Sabbas was drowned in the Tiber with a great stone about his neck in 272. It prints no hymn and names no relic.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

hymns.text: Lepădând dregătoria şi cinstea cea pământească, înaintea chinuitorului, împăratului celui viclean ai mărturisit pe Hristos Dumnezeu şi pentru El multe patimi ai suferit, mărite. Pentru aceasta te-ai încununat cu cununa preafrumoasă a biruinţei, de la Împăratul Cel Ce peste toţi împărăţeşte, luminat împodobindu-te. Şi cu Oştile cele cereşti stând înaintea lui Hristos, Sfinte Mucenice Sava, roagă-te să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Mucenic Sava Stratilat

english.text: Casting away office and earthly honour, before the torturer and the crafty emperor thou didst confess Christ God, and for him didst suffer many torments, O glorious one. Therefore thou wast crowned by the King who reigns over all with the most beautiful crown of victory, and wast adorned with light. And standing before Christ with the hosts of heaven, holy Martyr Sabbas, pray that our souls be saved.

death.note: saint.gr: «τον έριξαν στον ποταμό Τίβερη και έτσι πήρε το αμάραντο στεφάνι του μαρτυρίου το έτος 272 μ.Χ.», and the page heads him «(; - 272)»; no year of birth is printed.
